items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The Clarke-Boland band was a great swinging band. Benny Bailey, who is a great trumpet player, was there

ctx.x: During this time, you were working with the Clarke-Boland big band?
Yes, working with Clarke-Boland’s band and something other things too.
That reunited you with a lot of folks that you had known in New York.
